antacid.t: Warnings Do not use if you cannot swallow without chewing Ask a doctor before use if you have ▪ stomach pain, nausea or vomiting ▪ a sudden change in bowel habits that lasts more than 2 weeks When using this product ▪ do not chew or crush tablet(s) ▪ it may cause stomach discomfort, faintness and cramps ▪ do not use within 1 hour after taking an antacid or milk Stop use and ask a doctor if ▪ you have rectal bleeding or no bowel movement after using this product.
